title_sq: Apartament 1+1 per shitje tek Rruga Mine Peza
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 te Mine Peza, shume prane qendres se Tiranes!
Ndodhet ne katin e 3- te banim te nje pallati te vitit 2005, pa ashensor. ( Eshte rene dakort te vendoset se shpejti. )
Investimi i kryer ne apartament vlen te theksohet, duke qene se jane perdorur materialet me cilesore dhe me prestigjioze ne treg:
- Instalime elektrike dhe hidraulike të reja
- Rifinitura të punuara me arkitekt, duke shfrytëzuar çdo hapësirë në mënyrë efikase
- Vetrata duralumili termik
- Pllaka Pajtoni Ceramica
- Parket Pajtoni AC6
- Hidrosanitare Pajtoni incasso
- Punime gipsi dhe patinim me materiale KNAUF
- Dyer me lyerje
- Ndriçim EGLO
- Mobilje MDF me lyerje
- Elektroshtepiake të markave më cilësore, totalisht të reja
Per me teper informacion, me kontaktoni!
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale on Mine Peza Street
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Mine Peza, very close to the center of Tirana! It is located on the 3rd floor of a building built in 2005, without an elevator. (It has been agreed to be settled soon.) The investment made in the apartment is worth noting, since the highest quality and most prestigious materials in the market have been used: - New electrical and plumbing installations - Refinishing done with an architect, using every space efficiently - Thermal duralumin windows - Pajtoni Ceramica tiles - Pajtoni AC6 parquet - Pajtoni incasso hydrosanitary - Gypsum works and patination with KNAUF materials - Doors painted - EGLO lighting - painted MDF furniture - household appliances of the highest quality brands, totally new For more information, contact me!
